title: Verify: Dashboard shows correct data after BUG-026 migration
description: Verification story to confirm that after BUG-026 migrates the progress data, the user's dashboard correctly displays all their learning progress.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Verify: Lines completed count is > 0 (expected ~6, shows as 30/31)
Verify: Songs in progress shows at least 1 song
Verify: Practice streak data displays (if any)
Navigate to a practiced song to verify word progress shows
All dashboard stats match expected data from BUG-026 migration

notes:
This verification confirms BUG-026 fix worked correctly.

Expected data after migration:
- wordProgress: 65 records
- lineProgress: 6 records (displayed as 30/31 lines)
- userSongProgress: 1 record
- userWishlist: 1 record
- userPracticeLog: 2 records
- userPreferences: 1 record

If dashboard shows 0s for everything, the migration failed or the ID mismatch persists.
